messages:
noah-sales: FYI customer called for an exec escalation: HelioSync wants a written timeline + cleared blockers by Friday. Main asks: SSO (SAML + SCIM), EU-only processing for trial, and a pilot discount ask.

leo-se: Quick note on SAML: we support SP & IdP flows. For a clean test we need their IdP metadata, two test accounts, and an allowlist entry for our test IPs. We can stand up a test SP in the EU region behind a feature flag.

mika-infra: EU-only pilot  doable with Dedicated trial, but require reserved capacity. Lead time: 72 hours after approval + capacity slot. Cost estimate: approx €2,900/week.

noah-sales: HelioSync asked for 30% off first 6 months. Is that in-band for presales?

ana-legal: (typing) Ana-legal: Any concession >20% requires Deal Desk review and VP approval. Send projected ARR and pilot term and I'll kick off a fast-track review.

tina-cs: From CS: customer wants retention of logs <30 days and no transcript export outside EU during pilot. Need confirmation from infra and data team about retention policy.

sanjay-eng: SCIM: our default connector syncs email, name, and groups. We can support custom attrs but it's an engineering change (ETA ~5 days). If they can accept default attrs for pilot, we can avoid delay.

noah-sales: I'll ask them to accept default attrs for now and record the custom attr ask as post-pilot work.

leo-se: Test plan (short):
```
- Upload IdP metadata to SP
- Create two test users in IdP
- Run SP-initiated login + capture SAML assertion
- Validate SCIM provisioning and group mapping
```

mika-infra: Created infra ticket: DP-787 (Dedicated pilot request). Provision ETA 72h, will attach cost worksheet.

ana-legal: Please post ARR and proposed pilot term in this thread. I'll template the amendment and route to Deal Desk.

noah-sales: ARR estimate for pilot-to-enterprise path: €120k ARR (base). Pilot term: 6 weeks. Requesting 30% concession for first 6 weeks (not full year).

ana-legal: Received. Routing now. Deal Desk slack ping in ~2h.

leo-se: Once metadata + test accounts are in, I can run the SAML test tomorrow morning. Ping me here.

pete-ops: deploy-bot: job DP-787 queued. Will notify when nodes are ready.

tina-cs: HelioSync contact (Maya) said they'll share metadata and two test users by EOD.

noah-sales: Good. I'll consolidate and prepare a 1-pager for execs summarizing blockers, cost delta, and timelines. Will drop it in this thread when ready.

leo-se: ack. I'll hold a 30m window tomorrow at 09:30 CET for the test.

mika-infra: Noted. If Deal Desk approves concession, confirm and I'll start provisioning immediately.

noah-sales: Target: decision by Fri COB. If anything slips, flag here and I'll escalate to VP. :pray:
